description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory class, which creates various tasks related to Web Audio Player functionality in a media application. It uses Google Test framework to verify the creation of different task objects such as SetCaps, Play, Pause, Eos, Stop, Shutdown, SetVolume, WriteBuffer, and HandleBusMessage.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactoryTest
